blockers.message: 'Marriage registration (Delhi, Hindu Marriage Act)' needs Separate affidavits of husband and wife (prescribed format) for 'Separate affidavits of husband and wife'. None is held and no service in the knowledge base issues one.

'Marriage registration (Delhi, Hindu Marriage Act)' needs Attested passport-size and ceremonial photographs of both parties for 'Attested passport-size and ceremonial photographs'. None is held and no service in the knowledge base issues one.
'Aadhaar name update (e.g. after marriage)' cannot proceed until blocked step(s) are resolved: 'Marriage registration (Delhi, Hindu Marriage Act)'.
'Passport reissue for change of name after marriage' cannot proceed until blocked step(s) are resolved: 'Marriage registration (Delhi, Hindu Marriage Act)'.

reason.message: Obtain Separate affidavits of husband and wife (prescribed format) first. 'Marriage registration (Delhi, Hindu Marriage Act)' is blocked without it, and so are: 'Aadhaar name update (e.g. after marriage)', 'Passport reissue for change of name after marriage'.
